protocol: Controlled 7-arm TPU v6p (8 devices, seed 42, 113 shards / 1,260,635 clean utterances) ablation study isolating Clean-K3 LMFT self-impostor pruning vs. uncalibrated medoid sub-center collapse, SWA + exact population BatchNorm recalibration + Cohort QMF-v2, Inter-TopK + narrowband/tilt augmentation, 2D fwSE + 3-Stage MFA (V2-Large, 36.32M), 64.38M XL capacity scaling, and frozen-trunk Hybrid Cosine + PFAS attentive scoring.

ctrl_base_noprune.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer-Large (31.83M) + standard Stage-2 LMFT (retaining @sp0.9/@sp1.1 columns, no SWA/BN recalibration, QMF-v1)

clean_lmft_medoid_k1.description: Negative ablation: Stage-2 LMFT pruning @sp0.9/@sp1.1 with uncalibrated geometric-medoid K=3->1 sub-center collapse (collapse_subcenters=True)

clean_lmft_keep_k3_swa_bn.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer-Large (31.83M) + Clean-K3 LMFT (pruning @sp0.9/@sp1.1 while preserving K=3 sub-centers) + SWA/Exact Population BN + Cohort QMF-v2 + Length-Weighted Multi-Enroll

inter_topk_chan_aug_k3.description: Clean-K3 LMFT + SWA/Exact BN + Inter-TopK (k=5, m=0.06) + Narrowband (0.20) & Spectral-Tilt (0.25) channel augmentation

v2_large_fwse_mfa123.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer-V2-Large (36.32M: 2D fwSE + 3-Stage MFA + 3 RoPE Conformer layers) + Clean-K3 LMFT + SWA/Exact BN + Inter-TopK/ChanAug

xl_64m_clean_k3.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer-XL (64.38M: 80 base channels, (3,4,8,3) blocks, 640-D x 4 RoPE Conformer layers) + Clean-K3 LMFT + Exact BN + Inter-TopK/ChanAug

hybrid_pfas_attentive_scoring.description: Hybrid Cosine + Residual Multi-Key PFAS-SN (8 keys x (32+96), validation-calibrated alpha=0.10) trained for 12,000 episodes on frozen SimAM-ERes2Conformer-Large trunk

long_horizon_recipe_comparison.protocol: Matched full-corpus (145 shards / 1,708,852 clean utterances / 4,345,181 items / 12,193 speakers) long-horizon comparison isolating Clean recipe (inter_topk=0, narrowband_prob=0, spectral_tilt_prob=0) vs. InterAug recipe (inter_topk=5, inter_margin=0.06, narrowband_prob=0.20, spectral_tilt_prob=0.25) at 162,000 steps on SimAM-ERes2Conformer-V2-Large (36.32M) and 145,000 steps on SimAM-ERes2Conformer-XL (64.38M). Winner for both architectures selected strictly by held-out universal_full_val 1-utt EER.
